title: Evaluation of a Three-Literal Predicate
statement: A predicate consists of an integer $n$ with $0\le n<3$ and a Boolean pattern on $n+1$ coordinates. Given Boolean values on those coordinates, the predicate evaluates to true exactly when at least one coordinate differs from its prescribed pattern.
hypotheses_covered: $n$ is an element of $\mathrm{Fin}(3)$, so $0\le n<3$
The pattern and input each assign a Boolean value to every coordinate in $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$
